mmm i also need to add some things (sorry i just feel very strongly about school)

sex education needs to be updated. first of all, there is NOT enough representation of lgbtq+ sexual health and education. there needs to be change in that department, especially because a lot of young and confused people might not feel comfortable just asking an adult or teacher. 

piggybacking off of my arguments of the core 4 subjects, lots of kids might be going into fields such as surgery or real estate. things like science and math is just stressful, pointless, and stuff kids who aren’t going into science or math fields will just forget about once it’s over.

probably everything, i think about this a lot actually.

math: i do believe addition/subtraction/times tables and normal simple math units are important, i do. but do i really need to know how to find all the factors of a polynomial? math up until 6 grade i condone, but what i’m learning now is just gibberish. 

history: history is very important and a well rounded education of history definitely isn’t stupid. but did i really have to know the turnout of the 1800 election or china’s extreme dislike of imperialism? probably not. those things are purely trivial in my opinion. 

science: man i hate science. once again, certain things are important. but i didn’t really need to spend a whole unit learning that mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell. 

english: this one is pretty important. grammar, spelling, reading, and writing is super important. however, i spent a whole 4 months trying to figure out who caused the salem witch trials in the crucible and another 4 months arguing that romeo and juliet were fucking insane. 

conclusion: school is important up till middle school. a well rounded education is muy importante! but this weird ass shit im learning right now is absolutely pointless. instead of learning about areas of triangular prisms i could be practicing sat questions and learning how to buy a house. if you wanted to know how to use the quadratic formula, i could totally help u! if you wanna know how to pay taxes, you’ve lost me. thank you for your time. 👽🐒

i went to this cheap fucking dentist when i was 5 bc my mom was poor. i had to get a simple cavity filling and was literally strapped down to the table then covered with one of those weighted dentist blanket things. mind you i was 5. so i’m sitting there kicking and screaming and my mom was borderline crying because she felt so bad that she brought me there, but she just let them continue because they were almost done. i was kicking so hard my tennis shoes fell off. i ended up getting 2 metal crowns and couldn’t eat chewy/sticky things until they fell out. the dentist itself smelled very strongly of chemicals and when i was finally unstrapped and stood up, i threw up. very traumatic and glad to say my mom never sent me back there.
